expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, 15–25 min ETA and €0.90 delivery, which looks like a duplicated data entry or repeated list rendering bug.
The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its title is cut mid-word with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: a white circle with dark outline on the ramen card and a dark/translucent circle on the pizza card, so they appear inconsistent.
The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of an additional chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The second 'Popular right now' card is truncated by the bottom navigation bar with none of its title or metadata visible, so the section's last item appears incomplete.
